answer: One workable design: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because fable only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, onyx is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any karst approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
